name: Bugis
summary: DTL/EWL central retail hub — malls, arts adjacency, and condo/serviced edges with tourist footfall as the daily tax.
body: Bugis is the shortlist when Downtown + East-West interchange access and mall / arts density matter, with Victoria Street and Beach Road edges in walking range. Housing is mostly condo and serviced-apartment stock rather than quiet HDB heartland; weekend tourist crowds and late retail energy are the tax. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops and lifestyle density, not cul-de-sac calm. Compare with Lavender for slightly calmer city-fringe older stock, Farrer Park for a more residential north-of-Rochor texture, and Marina Bay / CBD when you are already paying core premiums and want the skyline walk.
bestFor: car-light workers who want two MRT lines and mall gravity
households okay with tourist weekend crowds
renters comparing serviced vs proper TA nearby
people who will book ActiveSG indoor courts instead of trusting condo facilities
watchOuts: Facility brochure vs MA booking reality in older condos
housingMix: Condo and serviced-apartment stock with limited quiet HDB texture.
commuteNotes: Downtown and East-West at Bugis; test Saturday afternoon station exits before you romanticise the interchange.
